$comment: Sierra Leonean Krio urgent messages. DRAFT translation derived from en.json, written in the standard Krio orthography (ɛ, ɔ); needs native-speaker review (including whether an informal e/o spelling reads better for UK users) and clinical adviser approval. Phone numbers and hrefs are byte-identical to en.json.

emergency.title: Dis kin bi emergency
body: Wetin yu tɔk kin bi siriɔs.
Nɔ wet fɔ si if i go bɛtɛ.
Dis app nɔ ebul chɛk sik sain, ɛn i nɔ ebul gi mɛdikal advays.
emergency.banner: Yu tɛl wi sɔntin we kin bi emergency. If yu nɔ dɔn du am yet, kɔl 999 naw.

urgent.title: Duya, go fɛn ɛp kwik
body: Wetin yu tɔk kin nid dɔktɔ ɔ nɔs fɔ luk am kwik.
Kɔntakt NHS 111 naw, na fon ɔ ɔnlayn, ɔ kɔl yu GP surgery if dɛn opin.
If i de wɔs, ɔ yu tink se na emergency, kɔl 999.
Dis app nɔ ebul chɛk sik sain, ɛn i nɔ ebul gi mɛdikal advays.
urgent.banner: Yu tɛl wi sɔntin we kin nid ɛp kwik. If yu nɔ dɔn du am yet, kɔntakt NHS 111 ɔ yu GP surgery.

crisis.title: Yu nɔ nid fɔ fes dis wan yu wan
body: I tan lɛk se yu de pas tru sɔntin we at bad bad naw.
Yu kin tɔk to Samaritans fri, ɛnitɛm, de ɔ nɛt. Kɔl 116 123.
If yu de na denja naw, ɔ yu kin du sɔntin bɔt dɛn tin we yu de tink, kɔl 999 naw.
Yu kin kɔl NHS 111 bak fɔ kwik ɛp fɔ mental health.
crisis.banner: Yu tɛl wi se yu kin de pas tru sɔntin we at bad bad. Samaritans de ɛnitɛm na 116 123. If yu de na denja naw, kɔl 999.

continueCheck.link: A nɔ de na denja, a want kɔntinyu
continueCheck.title: Bifo yu kɔntinyu
body: Kɔntinyu ɔnli if yu nɔ de na denja naw.
Samaritans de ɛnitɛm, de ɔ nɛt. Kɔl 116 123.
continueCheck.confirm: A nɔ de na denja naw
